issues.detail: The Greek 'εκ της αυλης ταυτης' (from this fold/pen) is singular, but the Vietnamese 'không thuộc về sân này' (not belonging to this yard) is acceptable. However, 'κακεινα με δει αγαγειν' (those [plural] I must lead) is rendered as 'ta cũng phải dẫn nó' (I also must lead it - singular). The Greek refers to 'προβατα' (sheep, plural), so the Vietnamese should be plural ('dẫn chúng').
